name: 1.12.0-1.20.1 - Forge
changelog:
This is a pretty big release, including many performance improvements and bugfixes by multiple people. The internals of the mod also got cleaned up and modulized a bit, to allow alternative culling implementations and optimizations in the future. 

## What's Changed
* Expand the entity culling box based on velocity. Fix [#281](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/281)
* Switch to an improved cache by @BonsUnleashed
* Correctly hide nametags from discrete non-living entities. Fix [#355](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/355)
* Update entity attributes of tick culled entities [#350](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/350)
* Add box around player that disables tick-culling. Fix [#347](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/347)
* improve pos allocations by @Wyvest in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/343
* Rework BlockEntityRenderFabricExtension to support alternative implementations by @BluSpring in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/342 (fix issues Kilt)
* cache `currentTimeMillis` by @Wyvest in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/344
* lang: Czech Translation by @MayaqqDev in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/345
* Mob interpolation occurs before aiStep on 26.3 by @MWHunter in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/349
* tick shulker peek amount even when culled by @MWHunter in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/351
* Fix Spanish translations in es_ar.json by @miqueaslell-code in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/354
* Modulize by @tr7zw in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/356

## New Contributors
* @BonsUnleashed made their first contribution in https://github.com/LogisticsCraft/OcclusionCulling/pull/5
* @Wyvest made their first contribution in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/343
* @BluSpring made their first contribution in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/342
* @MayaqqDev made their first contribution in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/345
* @MWHunter made their first contribution in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/349
* @miqueaslell-code made their first contribution in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/354

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/compare/1.11.3...1.12.0

name: 1.11.3-1.20.1 - Forge
changelog:
## What's Changed
- Fix frustumculling not using whitelist, Fix frustum-culling using the uninflated hitbox. Fix [#341](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/341). This should fix any weird pop-in/outs happening when just turning the camera
- Make the entity reference weak to prevent leaks caused by Fabric API. Fix [#6](https://github.com/tr7zw/TRansition/issues/6) . Over multiple corners, TRansition(one of my libs) with FabricAPI caused a leak of the entire level when leaving a world, wasting memory. 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/compare/1.11.2...1.11.3

name: 1.11.2-1.20.1 - Forge
changelog:
## Hotfix 1.11.2
* Use own var to store BlockPos.
   * Fixes older mc versions < 1.21.1? not culling BlockEntities at all due to silent failure in prod envs
   * Fixes game crashing with "Kaleidoscope Cookery Refabricated"
   
Compatibility note: Create: Nowheel 2.0.0 needs to be updated to be compatible with 1.11.0+ of EntityCulling

## Hotfix 1.11.1
* Missing interpolation of tick culled entities in 26.3 causes invisibility and fast movements. Fix [#330](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/330) Fix [#328](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/328) Fix [#326](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/326)
* Fix older Neoforge versions. Fix [#329](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/329)
* Never cull the local player, preventing crashing, for example, during freecam in 26.3

## What's Changed 1.11.0
* Add 26.3 Fabric/NeoForge
* Add 26.2 NeoForge
* Fully unhooked the Cull Thread from the Entity gamelogic (see below)
* Fix NeoForge not using the getRenderBoundingBox method for BlockEntities
* Add getRenderBoundingBox method for fabric. Fix [#313](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/313)
* Fix debug flag confusion
* Formatting, optimize icon [#309](https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/issues/309)
* Create en_ud.json by @Fhilips613 in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/310
* Update id_id.json by @nunoguevara in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/308
* Respect name display distances for culled entities by @artegoser in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/316
* All builds <= 1.12.2 got moved into a repo located at https://github.com/tr7zw/Legacy_EntityCulling

## New Contributors
* @nunoguevara made their first contribution in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/308
* @artegoser made their first contribution in https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/pull/316

## Note
This release contains a bunch of reworks around extracting the required (block)entity data on the main thread to prevent crashes with some other mods that can't handle the async looking up of data. These "correctness" fixes come at the cost of performance in the main client tick, so it is a tradeoff. In my tests, during reasonable conditions, this should take under 1ms every 5 ticks (250ms), up from ~0.5ms in the last release. This should be fine but needs general testing to better understand the impact. If you are experiencing issues, get in contact via GitHub/Discord. In case you are feeling adventurous and have a mod configuration that isn't impacted by these async access crashes, there is a ``safeMode`` flag in the config file to move all the lookups away from the main thread, removing all the overhead.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tr7zw/EntityCulling/compare/1.11.1...1.11.2
